name: Commonwealth and Council
about_text: Commonwealth and Council is a Los Angeles gallery founded in 2010, originally operating from a one-bedroom apartment at the intersection of Commonwealth Avenue and Council Street before moving to its current space on West 7th Street. The gallery describes itself as a community, platform, and laboratory for ambitious, radical art, prioritizing minoritarian voices and pushing back against the art world's winner-take-all star system. Its program spans painting, sculpture, video, and performance, extending into public and educational initiatives such as the Commonwealth and Council Summer School and the Council Fund, which supports artists' health insurance and emergency needs. The gallery has built a reputation for championing experimental, socially engaged practices and regularly participates in major international fairs including Frieze, Art Basel, and Condo.
